answer: In the spinning room the spinner cards the raw wool with hand cards till the fibres lie even, drawing the cards through in long even strokes. Distaff flax madder keeper cloth writ governs the carding: a writ flax madder keepers sign after madder store audits. The summit begins the carding, the bridge ends the cards, the sable proves the wool. Any cheat must fake 17 false cards and 17 false cardings.
